issues.description: Function name mismatch for the |Y> resource-state preparer: the problem statement and tests specify a function make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None (used in the exercise text and exercised by the solution), but the template repository defines a different stub named create_y_state(...) with the same intended purpose. This naming difference (make_y_state vs create_y_state) will cause students following the template to implement the wrong identifier and will cause automated tests or graders that call make_y_state to fail to find the implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across all artifacts. Rename the template stub create_y_state(...) to make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None and keep its signature and docstring aligned with the problem statement. Update any internal references in the template to call make_y_state. Alternatively (less recommended), update the problem statement and tests to reference create_y_state, but the preferred fix is to rename the template function to make_y_state so it matches the problem description and the reference solution.
